title: Studying Spanish
setting: A university library on a rainy spring day.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses

sentences.en: On a rainy spring day, Zoe and Raj study.
sentences.zh: 在一个下雨的春日，佐伊和拉吉在学习。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater and Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses sit at a desk with books, rain on the window and spring blossoms outside.

sentences.en: They sit in the library of their university.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在大学的图书馆里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater and Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses at a long table in a large university library with tall bookshelves.

sentences.en: Raj learns the Spanish language at his college.
sentences.zh: 拉吉在他的学院学习西班牙语。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses reads a Spanish textbook with a small Spanish flag on its cover.

sentences.en: He must describe his home in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 他得用西班牙语描述自己的家。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses thinks about his home, a small house in a thought bubble, pencil in hand.

sentences.en: He writes a hundred words in his book.
sentences.zh: 他在本子上写了一百个词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses writes in a notebook filled with many lines of handwriting.

sentences.en: Raj makes a mistake and feels angry.
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses looks angry at a mistake in his notebook, frowning.

sentences.en: Zoe gives him her eraser with a smile.
sentences.zh: 佐伊笑着把她的橡皮递给他。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater smiles and hands a pink eraser to Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses.

sentences.en: Then she helps him with her dictionary.
sentences.zh: 然后她用她的词典帮助他。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater opens a thick dictionary and shows a page to Raj, a young man with short black hair and glasses.
